caption: A woman walks along a city sidewalk carrying a handbag, one foot after the other.

sa.check: A woman walks along a city sidewalk.
Her feet move one after the other.
The setting is a city sidewalk.

pc.expect: Her legs alternate, her arms swing opposite to her legs, and her limbs bend only at hips, knees, elbows and shoulders.
pc.fail: Both legs move forward together; or a limb bends mid-bone; or her legs cross through each other.

pc.expect: One foot is on the ground at all times and her feet land on the pavement, not in it.
pc.fail: Both feet are off the ground at once during the walk; or a foot sinks into the pavement; or she slides forward with her feet still.

pc.expect: She stays upright with her weight over her feet.
pc.fail: She leans far over and does not fall; or she floats; or her body rises and drops far more than a step would.

pc.expect: The handbag stays in her hand or on her shoulder and swings with her.
pc.fail: The bag vanishes; or floats beside her; or passes through her body.

pc.expect: Her limbs keep their number and stay attached, and she passes through nothing.
pc.fail: A limb detaches, vanishes or a third arm appears; or she merges with a passer-by; or her head passes through a sign.

pc.expect: Her clothing, the bag and the street stay the same.
pc.fail: Her clothing changes colour; or the bag changes; or the buildings rearrange.

note: Biomechanics scene: the body is the physics. Gait, posture, style and skill are not judged; only that limbs stay attached, bend at joints, keep ground contact and pass through nothing.
